text:
Priya Sinha: heads up — nightly eval job `20260319-03` shows a ~3x spike in avg perplexity for the 'long-whitespace' prompt set. Failing examples look like missing tokens in the middle of prompts. tagging eng-ml for triage :eyes:
Kyle Moore: can you paste a couple of diffs or samples?
Priya Sinha: sure, here's one pair from the CSV (orig vs generated). notice the original has a non-breaking space between words, normalized prompt is squashed: 
```
ORIGINAL_PROMPT: 'Translate: Hello world — include the non-breaking space'
NORMALIZED_PROMPT: 'Translate: Helloworld — include the non-breaking space'
GENERATION: 'Helloworld'  <-- model output missing space token
```
Priya Sinha: other examples show bidi marks and multiple U+200B zero-width spaces being removed. The tokenizer run during eval seems to be collapsing these.
Morgan Lee: interesting. last change to prompt_normalizer.py was in PR #4921 (merged yesterday) — it added `strip_unicode_whitespace=True` to the default pipeline. that could explain it.
AJ Chen: running a quick repro locally against the new onboarded int4 build. if the harness normalizer removes NBSP before tokenization, token ids shift and sampling produces this collapse. i'll run the nightly bundle locally.
eval-bot: nightly-run 20260319-03 finished. avg_perplexity_long_whitespace: 18.2 -> 55.7 (baseline 18.1), failure_rate: 14% -> 47%.
Kyle Moore: can you grep for normalize_prompts flag across the runner/configs? we should check prod tokenizer behavior vs harness.
AJ Chen: grep shows runner/configs/nightly.yaml sets `normalize_prompts: true`. model onboarding scripts (used in model-store) explicitly set `unicode_normalize: false` when tokenizing. so harness normalizes but production onboarding does not. mismatch.
Morgan Lee: that mismatch is the smoking gun. PR #4921 changed the eval harness default without syncing onboarding.
Priya Sinha: timeline: failing nightly merged at 03:12 UTC, PR #4921 merged 02:58 UTC, first failure detected 03:30 UTC.
Kyle Moore: short-term mitigation: revert the normalize change in nightly runner and re-run the nightly. Also add prompt round-trip test that compares tokenization after normalization against production tokenizer.
AJ Chen: i reverted the runner default locally and kicked off a dry-run: `./scripts/run_evals --config nightly.yaml --job dryrun-20260319-repro`. local repro with normalization off yields outputs matching baseline.
deploy-bot: rolled candidate config revert to staging (cfg-20260319-revert).
Priya Sinha: long-term: we need a test in eval-harness that asserts (for all prompts) tokenization(harness_normalize(prompt)) == tokenization(prod_normalize(prompt)) or at least detect non-visible unicode differences and flag them. also add a small prompt set with NBSP / zero-width chars to the regression suite.
Morgan Lee: i'll open a follow-up PR to add explicit fields in configs so we don't rely on implicit defaults. PR will include a test harness case and a changelog note.
Priya Sinha: thanks all — marking this triaged. action items:
- Morgan: PR for tests + explicit config (ETA today)
- AJ: run full nightly after revert and confirm metrics (ETA 30m)
- Kyle: add regression prompt set to repo (ETA today)
- Priya: notify QA and the model-onboarding owner to check any in-flight models.

Priya Sinha: closing the thread when metrics look back to baseline. :white_check_mark:
